turn1_record_scope: Only the completed first-turn record was used; live turn2 state ignored.

map_only_stop_diagnostic.method: Use actual saved base check_motion with observed_objects empty solely to isolate static map terms. No dynamic candidate safety claim. Input w is rounded DBG and pose is 4-decimal CSV, not exact control-state replay. horizon3s/dt0.1/margin0.2 defaults unchanged.
map_only_stop_diagnostic.interpretation: Both follow and slow violate the map margin, while stop and rotations clear it. Logged stop_safe preserves the higher-priority safe stop. Rotation object safety is unavailable because the raw observations/candidate metrics were not logged.

test04_timeout_settle_contact.interpretation: Last recorded controlled command is back, and sampled motion remains backward through t600. The exact last unsampled control tick is unavailable. Timeout then skips the controller and publishes zero during settle. First counted contact at600.983 is in that interval; no chooser/sensor/trajectory samples after600 establish whether continued back would have avoided it.

test03_contact_distinction.interpretation: Contact occurs while controller is active. Last5s includes safe forward through585.5, unsafe follow586.0 then unsafe back586.5-587.5. The recorded current/forecast gap is an aggregate forecast, not current M5 geometry.
